changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Complete the login-status repair for users disabled by INACTIVE or SUSPENDED employee states. Only termination controls login deactivation.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE "${schema}"."user" AS login_user SET is_active = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM "${schema}".employee AS employee WHERE employee.tenant_id = login_user.tenant_id AND employee.user_id = login_user.id AND employee.is_deleted = FALSE AND UPPER(TRIM(employee.status)) IN ('INACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED') AND login_user.is_deleted = FALSE AND login_user.is_active = FALSE;
